reference.expression: cellArea * rate * integral_route K(distance(query, route(s))) ds
reference.units: per-grid-cell dose-equivalent; continuous dose density multiplied by normalized grid-cell area
reference.quadrature: 16-point Gauss-Legendre on the exact segment interval clipped by the compact support disk
reference.doseMapping: continuous line dose is rate times polyline arclength; the reference and production arm request the same total dose. Production default dab writes are generated by GasterDeposition and finalized with retire.

sensor.localOrder: 2 distances x 3 sides x 3 transverse band samples
sensor.wideScore: trailResponse*2.8 + (cos(offset)-1)*confidence*0.55; unit pheromone sensitivity, zero adherence/crowding, no jitter or RNG; diagnostic rank only
